name: Safe launch copy redaction and local publish receipt
trigger: Redact a secret-bearing launch-copy fixture, POST it through the real Markdown publish handler, then read the generated artifact through GET /d/:id.
observe: HTTP 201 local publish receipt and HTTP 200 served HTML
secret marker absent from stored Markdown and rendered HTML
unsafe inline script removed by the production renderer
public upload seam returns unavailable and performs no external write
expected: The sanitized copy is atomically stored and served with a receipt; the secret is absent, unsafe script is stripped, and no public upload occurs.
